📖 How to use

  1. Drag the slider or type an angle from 0° to 360°.
  2. Watch the red radius, the blue cosine and purple sine projections.
  3. Read sin, cos, tan and the point coordinates below the circle.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why is the y-axis flipped in the picture?

Screen coordinates grow downward, so the SVG flips the sine value — the math shown in the labels is the true (cos θ, sin θ).

When is tan undefined?

At 90° and 270°, where cos θ = 0 and the tangent line would be vertical (±∞).

What do the dashed lines show?

The dashed blue segment is the cosine (adjacent / hypotenuse) and the dashed purple segment is the sine (opposite / hypotenuse) for that angle.
